description: Fix issue detail layout containment and sidebar information architecture: bound repository metadata, make workflow stage navigation responsive on mobile, regroup the right rail by user intent, and make icon-only controls accessible.

tasks.title: Contain repository metadata and prevent issue-detail horizontal overflow
tasks.description: Bound repository metadata (name, base branch, git URL) within the Details column of IssueDetailPage: add min-w-0 to the grid/flex children, render the repository name and git URL on separate lines with break-all/break-words plus a title tooltip (and optional copy) on the URL span, and add overflow-x containment to the page content container so a long git URL cannot widen the viewport at desktop widths.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository name and git URL render within the Details column; the git URL span applies break-all/break-words and carries a title tooltip with the full URL.
The issue detail content container applies min-w-0 / overflow-x containment so a long git URL (e.g. https://github.com/suraciii/mohist.git) does not force page-level horizontal scroll at ~1280px.

Desktop-width component test in IssueDetailPage.test.tsx renders an issue with a long git URL and asserts the metadata is bounded within the Details group (break utility / containment testid present).
npx tsc -b passes and the affected vitest specs pass via npx vitest run.
tasks.output: IssueDetailPage.tsx Details metadata containment + page container overflow containment with updated component tests.
tasks.notes: Implements design Decision 1. Tests are structural under jsdom (assert utility classes / testids, not measured scrollWidth) per design Decision 6.

tasks.title: Make workflow stage navigation responsive on mobile
tasks.description: Use the existing useIsMobile() hook (768px) to render the WorkflowView StageBar as a horizontally scrollable stepper on mobile (overflow-x-auto, flex-nowrap, fixed min-w per StageBarCell) while keeping the desktop flex-1 side-by-side fill layout. selectedStage state, selection, and readOnly gating must remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<768px via useIsMobile) StageBar renders a scrollable-stepper variant (data-testid) where each stage cell has a minimum width and labels are not clipped or overflowing their hit area.
On desktop StageBar keeps the existing flex-1 side-by-side layout and all current selection/readOnly behavior.

WorkflowView.test.tsx overrides window.innerWidth / matchMedia to force the mobile branch and asserts the scrollable-stepper variant renders with all five stage labels (Plan, Build, Check, Integrate, Done) present and readable.
npx tsc -b passes and the affected vitest specs pass via npx vitest run.
tasks.output: WorkflowView.tsx StageBar / StageBarCell responsive variant with updated component tests.
tasks.notes: Implements design Decision 2. Tests use the matchMedia/innerWidth polyfill from tests/setup.ts to switch branches.

tasks.title: Regroup issue-detail right rail by user intent
tasks.description: Reorganize the IssueDetailPage right rail into distinct intent groups using the existing CardSection: Details (metadata), Latest Artifacts (inspection), Runtime/Sessions (group TaskProgressPanel + WorkflowSessionsPanel), Configuration (extract IssueModelSelector out of the Actions card), and Actions (state-changing controls only). Keep drift/interrupted/convergence as status alerts. Ensure safe inspection links (artifacts, transcripts, View files, commits) are not interleaved with mutating actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Right rail renders distinct, visually separated intent groups: Details, Latest Artifacts, Runtime/Sessions, Configuration, and Actions.
IssueModelSelector (Coder Model + per-stage overrides) is moved out of the Actions card into a Configuration group.
TaskProgressPanel and WorkflowSessionsPanel are grouped under a Runtime/Sessions group.

The Actions group contains only state-changing actions (start, stop, force stop, retry, rerun, resume, close, reopen); safe inspection links are visually distinct and not interleaved with mutating actions (satisfies specs/web-ui/spec.md#issue-detail-separates-inspection-links-from-state-changing-actions).
Component test asserts the intent groups render and that IssueModelSelector is outside the Actions group; existing issue model-override behavior tests still pass.
npx tsc -b passes and the affected vitest specs pass via npx vitest run.
tasks.output: IssueDetailPage.tsx right-rail regrouping (metadata / artifacts / runtime-sessions / configuration / actions) with updated component tests.
tasks.notes: Implements design Decisions 3 and 4. Edits overlapping JSX with T-001; apply in priority order so T-001's Details containment is preserved. No behavior, data, or API change.

tasks.title: Make icon-only controls accessible with adequate hit targets
tasks.description: Add explicit accessible names (aria-label or equivalent) to icon-only controls on issue detail (the Edit issue button is the primary example) and ensure primary icon-only touch/click targets use the project's standard icon-button variant as the hit-target baseline, avoiding sub-baseline sizes for primary controls on desktop and mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: All icon-only controls on issue detail expose an accessible name (aria-label or equivalent accessible-name mechanism), including the edit-issue-button.
Primary icon-only touch/click targets use the project's standard icon-button variant sizing (not a sub-baseline size) on desktop and mobile.
Component test asserts icon-only controls such as the edit-issue-button expose an aria-label / accessible name.
npx tsc -b passes and the affected vitest specs pass via npx vitest run.
tasks.output: IssueDetailPage.tsx (and any other issue-detail icon-only controls) accessible names + baseline hit-target sizing with updated component tests.
tasks.notes: Implements design Decision 5. Apply after T-003 so the audit covers the final regrouped rail; uses existing button variants as the baseline per design Decision 5.
